sign_convention.mode_factor: the numerical mode relative to the exact one after H box crossings is exp(-i H N theta e_1(theta))
sign_convention.packet_error: e_H = || sum_k A_k (exp(-i H N theta_k e_1(theta_k)) - 1) exp(i k x) || / || sum_k A_k exp(i k x) ||
sign_convention.lag: a positive argument of the relative factor is a backward displacement, so e_1 < 0 lags and e_1 > 0 leads; the signed lag is -2 pi H e_1(theta_c) in length, a signed fraction -H e_1(theta_c) of the box, and the signed carrier phase lag is -H N theta_c e_1 radians

packet.definition: A(theta) = exp(-(theta - theta_c)^2 / (4 s^2)) on the one-sided grid spectrum, s = 0.1 pi / z_0.995

time_stepping.per_step_defect: log g(-i y) + i y = -y^4 / 24 + y^6 / 72 - i y^5 / 30, y = (dt / h) kappa_1
time_stepping.exact_time_landing: one partial final step of length T - n_full dt
